title: New transmission line proposed to serve eastern South Dakota
summary: SIOUX FALLS, S.D. (September 8, 2026) — Otter Tail Power Company and Xcel Energy filed an application for a transmission line Facility Permit that will help meet the significant electric growth predicted for South Dakota and the surrounding region. ...
body_markdown:
SIOUX FALLS, S.D. (September 8, 2026) — Otter Tail Power Company and Xcel Energy filed an application for a transmission line Facility Permit that will help meet the significant electric growth predicted for South Dakota and the surrounding region.


PowerOn Midwest is anchored by a new 765-kilovolt backbone transmission line that will connect eastern South Dakota, southern Minnesota and the broader Upper Midwest region. The project will strengthen grid reliability, reduce system congestion and help ensure homes, farms, schools, hospitals and businesses have the reliable electricity they need as demand for electricity continues to grow in the coming decades.


“South Dakota’s energy needs are growing, and we’re taking action to ensure residential and business customers have the reliable power they need,” said Bria Shea, president, Xcel Energy–Minnesota, North Dakota and South Dakota. “By investing in a strong electric grid today, we can enable economic growth, support thriving communities and build the energy infrastructure that homes and businesses will count on in South Dakota and across the entire Upper Midwest.”


“Because electricity is essential to daily life, our responsibility is to provide reliable service our customers can count on,” said Todd Wahlund, president, Otter Tail Power. “Meeting that responsibility requires long-term planning. PowerOn Midwest will strengthen the transmission system and help us continue delivering the dependable service our communities rely on every day.”


Beginning in October 2025, PowerOn Midwest began working with landowners and local community leaders to provide information about the proposal and ask for feedback on preliminary route options. Following additional review and outreach to government officials and state agencies, the project team identified revised route options and held additional open houses throughout the project area. Informed by more than 150 public comments, the proposed route meets state criteria while limiting impacts for landowners throughout eastern South Dakota.


The South Dakota Public Utilities Commission will review the application, schedule public information meetings throughout the project area and hold public hearings. A decision is expected in late 2027 or early 2028. Otter Tail Power Company and Xcel Energy will also file applications for local permits in Brookings, Deuel and Grant counties.


Learn more about **[PowerOn Midwest](http://www.poweronmidwest.com/)** and see detailed maps of the proposed route.


**About PowerOn Midwest**


PowerOn Midwest is a series of new electric transmission projects anchored by a 765 kV backbone transmission line being developed by Great River Energy, ITC Midwest, and Xcel Energy in Minnesota, and Otter Tail Power Company and Xcel Energy in South Dakota. The projects will connect eastern South Dakota, southern Minnesota and the broader region, enhancing grid reliability in the Upper Midwest to meet growing and evolving energy needs in the coming decades.


Learn more atPowerOnMidwest.com .


**About Otter Tail Power Company**


Otter Tail Power Company, a subsidiary of investor-owned Otter Tail Corporation (Nasdaq Global Select Market: OTTR), is headquartered in Fergus Falls, Minnesota. The company generates, transmits, and distributes electricity to approximately 134,200 customers in 422 communities across 70,000 square miles of Minnesota, North Dakota, and South Dakota.
